name: MacKenzie Golf Bags

picks.title: Waxed Canvas Mac – 8" Opening / 1 Pocket – Charcoal / Navy / Red / White (made to order)
picks.why: TGI's 7 Bags That Stand Out picked MacKenzie's 8" Waxed Canvas Mac in charcoal with navy trim as 'their classic carry bag', and MacKenzie says its Martexin-waxed canvas 'can handle legitimate rain'. Photos are real MacKenzie bags from the brand’s gallery.
picks.reference_note: reference_images are real photos of the ready-to-ship 8" Waxed Canvas Mac Charcoal, Navy & White ($760, SOLD OUT) that TGI covered; the made-to-order design adds red and differs slightly. images[0] is the builder render (500x500).

picks.title: Leather Mac – 8" Opening / 1 Pocket – Mahogany / Bittersweet / Gold (made to order)
picks.why: MacKenzie began in 1985 with a 'beautiful, uncomplicated leather golf bag' inspired by St Andrews caddie Rick MacKenzie's pencil bag, and says of leather: 'it's our bread and butter'. Photos are real MacKenzie bags from the brand’s gallery.
picks.reference_note: images[0] is the builder render; images[1-4] are photos from the matching ready-to-ship 8" Leather Mac Mahogany, Bittersweet & Gold page ($1,125.00, SOLD OUT), same 8in single-pocket spec and colorway.

picks.title: The Mac, built to order in your colours
picks.why: Every Mac can be built to order in the colours and materials you choose; nylon starts at $450, and the bags shown are customer builds from MacKenzie’s own gallery.
picks.reference_note: reference_images are photos of the ready-to-ship 8" Nylon Mac Olive, Tan & Cream ($475.00, SOLD OUT), which is single-pocket; the made-to-order design is two-pocket.

alternates.title: Valuables Pouch – Mahogany / Cream (made to order)
alternates.why: The valuables pouch is one of the custom pieces in MacKenzie's builder alongside the bag, shoe bag and headcovers, built in the same materials as the bags.

alternates.title: Driver Headcover – Bittersweet (made to order)
alternates.why: MacKenzie's builder offers driver, fairway and hybrid headcovers made to match its bags; every suggested driver design lists at $100.

notes: Not Shopify: Concrete CMS store with a custom bag builder. Every ready-to-ship listing (all 37 ready-to-ship bags, plus pouches, wallets and scorecard holders) shows SOLD OUT; only a caddie towel, socks, snapback hat and trestle sticks are in stock as ready-to-ship. The live way to buy is made-to-order through /builder/ (site banner: lead time about 8-10 weeks), so picks are the brand's own 'Suggested Designs' builder configurations with their listed prices; in_stock=true means orderable made-to-order, not ready to ship. Builder prices were read from the static builder landing page; the configurator itself needs JavaScript, so the final configured price was not confirmed. TGI's 8" Waxed Canvas Mac Charcoal/Navy ($740 in TGI's post) is now $760 and SOLD OUT. Images are the brand's own /files/cache/ files; builder renders are only 500x500 and no larger originals were found. TGI's MacKenzie Collab Archive covers partner-store bags that are not on mackenziegolfbags.com, so none were used. The 'MacKenzie Walker' is the name the brand's story page gives its original bag; the shop now calls the bags 'Mac'.
